channel.title: Marcin Skalski's Blog
channel.description: Agentic AI, LLM systems, agent harnesses, and production engineering.

item.title: How Kong Built an Agentic Engineering Platform
item.description: Originally published on the Kong blog. I explain how we built KSAI to run AI code reviews in GitHub Actions, with sandboxed agents and model traffic routed through Kong AI Gateway. The post covers review triage, model benchmarks, and rolling the platform out across engineering teams.

item.title: Leveraging Mesh Global Rate Limit Policy in Kong Mesh 2.3
item.description: Originally published on the Kong blog. This short introduction to MeshGlobalRateLimit covers coordinated rate limits across service instances, headerbased policies, external services, mesh gateways, and Redisbacked configuration.

item.title: Stop Wasting Your Engineers’ Time and Start Improving Your System Stability with Kuma
item.description: Originally published on the Kong blog. I look at the engineering cost of handling servicetoservice networking in every application and how Kuma moves concerns such as mTLS, resiliency, and observability into a shared service mesh layer.
